short_description_zh: 沈周（1427-1509），字启南，号石田，晚号白石翁，长洲（今苏州）人，明代吴门画派创始人，与文徵明、唐寅、仇英并称明四家。一生未仕，以诗书画名世。
short_description_en: Shen Zhou (1427-1509), courtesy name Qinan, pseudonym Shitian, was a founder of the Wu School of Ming dynasty painting, celebrated as one of the Four Masters of the Ming.
